props.name: columnIndexStart
props.description:
`aria-colindex` of the first of `columns`. Raise it when cells render before them, and set
`aria-colcount` on the table to the full column count.

props.name: columnLayout
props.description: Geometry of cells outside `columns`, such as pinned ones.

props.name: columns
props.description:
Columns to virtualize horizontally, in display order. Used when the virtualizer has the
`columns` option; render the cells of each row with `Table.VirtualCells`.

props.name: columnSize
props.description: Width in px of a column, used when the virtualizer's `columns.estimateSize` is not set.

props.name: itemRender
props.description: Renders one item as a single `Table.Row`.

props.name: items
props.description: Every body row, in display order.

props.name: scrollElement
props.description:
Scroll container, when an ancestor of the table scrolls. Defaults to the host `tbody`,
which must then be a bounded block.

props.name: virtualizer
props.description: Virtualizer that renders only the visible rows.

props.name: itemRender
props.description:
Renders one visible column as a single `Table.Cell`. Placeholder cells fill the skipped
columns, so the row still spans every column of the header.
